record.body:
## Description

Document the loop the skills actually implement.

## Approach

Add a lifecycle section to `README.md`. Describe specify and design as `discuss` records, plan as `plan-phase` with requirement and decision ids, execute and the integration-report as `execute-phase`, verify and assessment as `verify-work`, and release as a `ready` record with no deployer. Include the assessment `next` routes: sufficient evidence to release; insufficient evidence back to verify; implementation to execute; design to design; plan to plan; specification to specify. State that a git merge is not integration success and that a passing test is not verification of every requirement. Describe `feedback` as a record `engage` can route, with no collector.

Add `tests/test_readme_lifecycle.py` that reads `README.md` and asserts it names each stage and those routes.

Document only behavior the skills already state. Do not edit the skills.
